tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Page background. Dark is the default theme.

tokens.name: color-bg-alt
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Alternate band: a section that needs to separate from the page.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Cards and panels, one layer above the page.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Raised layer: menus, hover states, inline code.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Hairlines and card outlines, one step above the layer they outline. Decorative.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Control borders (secondary button outline, inputs) and dividers that must show. TO CHECK: 1.52:1 on color-bg (dark) and 1.54:1 on white (light), below the 3:1 a control border needs where it is the only cue (inputs); the live secondary outline border--border-dark-grey #666 is 3.29:1. A button with a text label passes without it.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Headings and primary text. Worst case on page, surface and raised: 14.52:1 dark, 17.94:1 light.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Body text and secondary text. Worst case on page, surface and raised: 6.92:1 dark, 9.41:1 light.

tokens.name: color-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Captions, meta lines, placeholders. Replaces the live grey-medium #717275, which fails on dark. Worst case on page, surface and raised: 4.79:1 dark, 5.45:1 light.

tokens.name: color-link
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Links in running text, eyebrows, icons in link colour. Blue-600 is never text on dark. Worst case on page, surface and raised: 4.60:1 dark, 6.33:1 light.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Focus ring (2px, 3px offset) and focused input border.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Error text and the error border of a form field. Worst case on page, surface and raised: 6.67:1 dark, 6.36:1 light.

tokens.name: color-frame
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Frame lines, cell dividers and the hatched band of the frame (web library layout).

tokens.name: color-frame-marker
tokens.usage: Role (web library). The plus markers where a ruled section meets the frame lines.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Primary button and other blue fills. One primary per group.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: color-accent-fill-press
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Role (web library). Text and icons on the accent fill.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand blue, the one action colour (= social--main-blue #3B41EC). Use through color-accent-fill. 6.66:1 under white text.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Brand blue on hover (#3235CF). Replaces the live social--button-hover #272b9d.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Brand blue while pressed (#282BAD). Replaces the live social--button-pressed #27265e.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the brand blue.

tokens.name: gradient-light-blue
tokens.usage: Gradient stop (= live gradient--light-blue). Gradients are backgrounds or shapes, never text.

tokens.name: gradient-medium-blue
tokens.usage: Gradient stop (= live gradient--medium-blue). 3.95:1 on #111: never text on dark.

tokens.name: social--dark
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `neutral-950`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Default page background (dark-first). Ground of every dark section; white and grey-light text sit on it.

tokens.name: text--text-color-grey-light
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `neutral-400`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Secondary text on dark: the body text colour of every page. 9.01:1 on social--dark, 8.30:1 on social--dark-gray-background, 7.59:1 on social--grey, 4.65:1 on social--light-grey.

tokens.name: main--white
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable. Text on dark (headings, button labels: 6.66:1 on social--main-blue); light background. The site writes the keyword `white`.

tokens.name: gradient--medium-blue
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `gradient-medium-blue`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Blue gradient middle; plain links and superscripts on the site (3.95:1 on social--dark, large text and UI only, TO CHECK); 4.78:1 on main--white. Never a CTA.

tokens.name: text--text-color-grey-dark
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `neutral-700`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Secondary text on light: 9.91:1 on main--white, 9.41:1 on social--grey-background, 9.09:1 on main--whitesmoke. Email body text.

tokens.name: secondary--green
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `green-300`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Status: success (8.45:1 as text on social--dark); decoration. Never a CTA; never white text on it (2.24:1).

tokens.name: social--grey
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, not in the new palette: when merging, replace with color-surface (neutral-850 #202022). Dark card and panel: card-v1 gradient start, product tiles.

tokens.name: secondary--red
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `red-400`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Status: error (5.24:1 as text on social--dark; white on it only for large text, 3.61:1). Never a CTA.

tokens.name: main--transparant
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable. Transparent (spelled with an "a" on the site). Outline cards and transparent fills.

tokens.name: social--main-blue
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `blue-600`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. The one action colour: primary button, tags, icon holders, brand fill. White label on it (6.66:1). Never as text or icon colour on dark (2.84:1 on social--dark); as text only on white (6.66:1) or whitesmoke (6.11:1).

tokens.name: gradient--light-blue
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, same value as `gradient-light-blue`. Keep it for the captured sections; new work uses the role tokens. Blue gradient start; info status colour; decoration. Never a CTA.

tokens.name: gradient--dark-blue
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable. Blue gradient end (an alias of social--main-blue on the site: `var(--social--main-blue)`).

tokens.name: text--text-color-grey-medium
tokens.usage: Live Webflow variable, not in the new palette: when merging, replace with color-text-subtle (neutral-500 #939497). Muted text. 3.93:1 on social--dark, 3.62:1 on social--dark-gray-background: large text (19px bold, 24px) and UI only on dark, TO CHECK for the nav and footer small text. 4.81:1 on main--white, 4.57:1 on social--grey-background; 4.41:1 on main--whitesmoke (fails body text there: use text--text-color-grey-dark).

tokens.name: border--border-dark

tokens.name: social--grey-background
